regression_origin.subject: fix: port complete package symbol model
regression_origin.evidence: The commit introduced has_class_symbol_container and promoted CLASS above every competing score while its viability model omitted DESCRIPTION-only bracket shorthand.

claimed_invariant: A shared package-symbol opener does not establish CLASS ownership. For generic @startuml, ClassDiagramFactory wins only if every later line is accepted by its command grammar. Bare bracket component declarations and bracket-endpoint links are DESCRIPTION commands and reject the earlier Class candidate.
causal_divergence: Rust scores bracket syntax as Component evidence but does not feed it into Class-factory viability. The symbol-container override consequently revives a Java candidate that failed at the first bracket shorthand line, dispatching to a Class model that discards the leaves and links.
planned_model_change: Recognize exact DESCRIPTION-only bracket declaration and bracket-endpoint link grammar, excluding class qualifiers, guards, URLs, and arrow styles, and invalidate Class-factory viability before score promotion. Preserve existing scores and dispatch the source through Diagram::Component.
